rawOutput:
1. **[blocker] [apps/web/wrangler.jsonc](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/wrangler.jsonc#L11) (and [apps/web/src/pages/404.astro](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/src/pages/404.astro#L1)) — `"assets": { "not_found_handling": "404-page", "run_worker_first": ["/_emdash/*"] }` blocks the Worker from running on any non-`/_emdash/*` URL while all site routes and `404.astro` are SSR-only (`output: "server"` without `export const prerender = true`).** — On the deployed Worker, requesting `/`, `/posts`, `/posts/welcome`, `/about`, `/category/general`, `/tag/starter`, `/sitemap.xml`, or `/robots.txt` (in production) misses `dist/client/` (which only contains `/spike/*` and `/_astro/*`), does not match `run_worker_first: ["/_emdash/*"]`, and is terminated at Cloudflare's static asset layer with an empty HTTP 404 without ever invoking the Worker; even genuine 404 requests return an empty body because `src/pages/404.astro` is not prerendered into `dist/client/404.html`.

2. **[major] [apps/web/astro.config.mjs](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/astro.config.mjs#L22-L27) — `emdash({...})` omits `localMedia({ enabled: false })` in `mediaProviders` and omits `storage`, leaving EmDash's built-in `"local"` ("Library") media provider active as the default provider and backed by `DEFAULT_STORAGE = local({ directory: "./.emdash/uploads", ... })` (`node:fs`).** — In the EmDash admin media picker (`/_emdash/admin`), the built-in "Library" (`id: "local"`) tab remains the first/default tab ahead of Cloudinary; uploading an image through that default tab (`POST /_emdash/api/media`) or via MCP `media_upload` invokes `LocalStorage.upload()` (`node:fs/promises` `mkdir`/`writeFile`) inside `workerd`, which either fails or writes to an isolate-local ephemeral VFS so `/_emdash/api/media/file/<key>` 404s across requests/isolates.

3. **[major] [apps/web/.dev.vars.example](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/.dev.vars.example#L4) (with [package.json](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/package.json#L42)) — Defining `CLOUDFLARE_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_HYPERDRIVE` and `SITE_ENV=local` in `.dev.vars` (copied from `.dev.vars.example`) causes `@astrojs/cloudflare`'s `loadWranglerEnv()` (`unstable_getVarsForDev`) to overwrite `process.env` during `astro:config:done` before the build-time `prerender` Worker boots.** — When a developer has `apps/web/.dev.vars` present and runs `pnpm deploy:testing:build`, `loadWranglerEnv()` clobbers `CLOUDFLARE_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_HYPERDRIVE="$SUPABASE_TESTING_POOLER_URL"` with `postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres` (and `SITE_ENV=local`), so prerendered pages in the testing build either query the local dev database instead of the testing Supabase pooler or fail the build with `ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:54322` when local Supabase is stopped.

4. **[major] [apps/web/src/lib/cloudinary-media/provider.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/src/lib/cloudinary-media/provider.ts#L96) (and [apps/web/src/lib/cloudinary-media/sign.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/src/lib/cloudinary-media/sign.ts#L64)) — `buildUploadRequest()` signs `folder: "growgen"` while `list()` queries `/resources/image/upload?prefix=growgen/`, which filters by `public_id` prefix (Fixed Folder Mode) rather than `asset_folder` (Cloudinary's default Dynamic Folder Mode).** — On any Cloudinary account in Dynamic Folder Mode (the default for accounts created since mid-2024), `upload()` places assets in `asset_folder: "growgen"` with an unprefixed `public_id` (e.g. `"hero_abc123"`), so `list()` (`prefix=growgen/`) returns zero items and uploaded images do not appear in the EmDash media browser.

5. **[major] [apps/web/src/lib/cloudinary-media/provider.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/src/lib/cloudinary-media/provider.ts#L139) — `getEmbed()` unconditionally calls `need(..., "CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME")` instead of falling back to `value.meta?.cloudName` (already persisted by `toItem()` at line 89).** — When `pnpm deploy:testing:build` (or any prerender build) renders `<Image image={post.data.featured_image} />` from `"emdash/ui"` without `CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME` exported in the root `.env` (because it is stored as a Worker secret), `getEmbed()` throws `Cloudinary: missing CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME`, and `EmDashImage.astro` catches the error and falls back to broken `/_emdash/api/media/file/<id>` URLs in the generated HTML.

6. **[major] [apps/web/src/middleware.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/src/middleware.ts#L51) (and [apps/web/astro.config.mjs](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/astro.config.mjs#L22)) — The setup gate and `X-Robots-Tag` middleware is registered as a standard Astro user middleware (`src/middleware.ts`) instead of `emdash({ middleware: { outer: "./src/middleware.ts" } })`, so it runs after all six EmDash `order: "pre"` middlewares.** — Any unauthenticated request to `/_emdash/admin/setup` or `/_emdash/api/setup/*` without `SETUP_TOKEN` still executes `emdash/middleware` first—opening a Hyperdrive Postgres connection, running cold-start migrations, and applying `seed/seed.json`—before `src/middleware.ts` returns 404; additionally, any response short-circuited by EmDash's `pre` middlewares (302 redirects from `setup`/`auth`/`redirect` or 503 migration responses) bypasses `withRobots()` and omits `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` in non-production environments.

7. **[minor] [apps/web/package.json](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/package.json#L14) — `"deploy": "astro build && wrangler deploy"` omits `-c dist/server/wrangler.json` and `node scripts/post-build.mjs`.** — Running `pnpm --filter web deploy` hits the repo-root `wrangler.json` config-redirect collision documented in [apps/web/TEMPLATE_DIFF.md](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/TEMPLATE_DIFF.md#L37), and in non-production environments deploys `dist/client` without the `noindex` `_headers` rule and disallow-all `robots.txt`.

8. **[minor] [apps/web/package.json](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/package.json#L21-L24) — `@emdash-cms/cloudflare` and `emdash` are specified as caret ranges (`"^1.5.0"`) even though `1.6.0` is installed and `@emdash-cms/cloudflare` requires an exact peer version match with `emdash`.** — A partial `pnpm update` can resolve different versions for `emdash` and `@emdash-cms/cloudflare`, triggering `adapterVersionMismatchWarning` at build time and virtual-module/worker runtime incompatibilities.

9. **[minor] [apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts#L4-L10) — Checked-in `Cloudflare.Env` types still declare the template's removed `MEDIA: R2Bucket` and `DB: D1Database` bindings instead of `HYPERDRIVE`, `EMDASH_ROOMS`, `SESSION`, `SITE_ENV`, and `SETUP_TOKEN`.** — `pnpm --filter web typecheck` validates against nonexistent `DB`/`MEDIA` bindings while requiring unsafe `env as unknown as ...` casts across `src/middleware.ts`, `src/plugins/rebuild-on-publish/plugin.ts`, and `src/lib/cloudinary-media/runtime.ts`.

10. **[minor] [package.json](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/package.json#L6-L8) — Root `package.json` lists `"workspaces": ["packages/*"]` while [pnpm-workspace.yaml](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/pnpm-workspace.yaml#L1-L3) lists both `"packages/*"` and `"apps/*"`.** — Tooling that reads `package.json#workspaces` rather than `pnpm-workspace.yaml` fails to discover `apps/web` as a workspace package.
